en.t: The move was set for the autumn equinox.

units.source_text: 原定大家一起迁入，但秋好皇后嫌其骚扰，略略延期。

en.t: Originally everyone was to move in together, but Empress Akikonomu disliked the commotion and postponed her move slightly.

units.source_text: 一向和光同尘的花散里，则于秋分之夜和紫姬一同迁入。

en.t: Hanachirusato, who had always lived modestly and harmoniously among others, moved in on the night of the autumn equinox together with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 紫姬所爱的春院，与此时季节不合，但也饶有雅趣。

en.t: The spring residence beloved by Lady Murasaki did not suit the season, but it still had abundant elegance and charm.

units.source_text: 紫姬乔迁用的车辆，共十五台。

en.t: There were fifteen carriages in all for Lady Murasaki's move.

units.source_text: 前驱者大都是四位、五位的京官。

en.t: Most of the men leading the procession were capital officials of the fourth and fifth ranks.

units.source_text: 也有六位殿上人，但都选用亲信者。

en.t: There were also courtiers of the sixth rank, but all of them were chosen from trusted retainers.
This display could not be called especially grand.

units.source_text: 为欲避免世人讥评，故一切从简，并无豪华盛大之举。

en.t: In order to avoid public criticism, everything was kept simple, with no lavish or magnificent ceremony.

units.source_text: 花散里的排场并不亚于紫姬。

en.t: Hanachirusato's procession was in no way inferior to Lady Murasaki's.

units.source_text: 大公子夕雾侍从奉陪，照料一切。

en.t: The young lord Yugiri attended her as an escort and took care of everything.
Everyone thought that this was only proper.

units.source_text: 侍女等各有专用房室，仔细隔分，这新院的设备可谓周到之至了。

en.t: The waiting women each had their own rooms, carefully partitioned, and the arrangements of the new residence could truly be called perfectly thorough.

units.source_text: 过了五六日，秋好皇后从宫中回来，也乔迁入院。

en.t: After five or six days, Empress Akikonomu returned from the palace and also moved into the residence.

units.source_text: 其仪式虽然简朴，亦颇盛大。

en.t: Although her ceremony was simple, it was still quite splendid.

units.source_text: 这位皇后幸运之佳，自不待言。

en.t: It goes without saying how exceptionally fortunate this empress was.

units.source_text: 其仪态之优美与大方，亦迥异寻常，最为世人所尊敬。

en.t: Her graceful and dignified bearing was also far beyond the ordinary, and she was held in the highest respect by all.

units.source_text: 这六条院中各区隔离，但有曲廊相通，可以互相往来，因此诸女友常得叙晤，乐趣甚多。

en.t: In the Rokujo estate, the various quarters were separated, but winding corridors connected them so people could visit one another, and thus the women friends could often meet and talk, bringing them much pleasure.
